$comment: Written by test/golden/validate/capture.ts. The legacy validator's result for each validate fixture case, captured on a maintainer machine. CI never runs Python.

normalizations.N1: The temporary folder is removed from every path. A leading system/ is removed from each finding path, and \ in it becomes /. A crash keeps only its last stderr line.
normalizations.N2: The case runs in the source layout: the project files under system/, and each saved doc_anchor under docs/ and source_anchor under assets/ spelled system/docs/ and system/assets/, as the source checkout spells them (register D-004).
